reason: The plan hits all hard requirements — three named phases with percentages summing to 100% and entry/exit criteria, five correctly formatted RISK lines, numeric halt thresholds, and a closing PHASES: 3 line — while explicitly deferring old-system decommissioning to a phase after the final migration batch; the only soft spot is that the Phase 3 exit criterion introduces a 'read-only cooldown' for the old system, which brushes close to the disabling restriction even though decommissioning itself is kept separate.
